summary: Prepared a hash-bound 13-image C-C-preserving and O-H-densified rebuild seed plus a dual-model routing plan: MatRIS primary and AQCat25 fixed-path secondary for TS paths, with no GPU or VASP submission.

payload.objective: Implement and review a dual-model GPU path workflow for Fe(110) C2HO* + H* -> C2H2O* + * using MatRIS as the TS-path primary model and AQCat25 as the exact-structure secondary model.
current_evidence: The supplied Fe-C-O-H MatRIS checkpoint hash exactly matches the checkpoint already loaded successfully by the MZ73 same-structure benchmark job 1311 through the repository MatRIS loader.

The existing 39-structure same-structure VASP benchmark supports AQCat25 as the adsorption primary model and MatRIS as the TS-path primary model: adsorption force-vector RMSE is 0.06523 versus 0.09618 eV/A, while TS-path force-vector RMSE is 0.10998 versus 0.09291 eV/A for AQCat25 and MatRIS respectively.

A 13-image segmented-IDPP seed was generated from IS-A to FS-A with five O-H-forming images in the 1.1-1.8 A interval, C1-C2 distances of 1.3994-1.4282 A, maximum adjacent mobile-atom RMSD 0.1764 A, and a passing kinematic geometry review.

The seed is not a converged MEP or accepted TS path. MatRIS-primary ML-NEB, temporary C-C restraint removal, and AQCat25 fixed-path secondary evaluation are not yet wired into a reviewed production executor.
No GPU or VASP job was submitted.
payload.one_executable_step: Implement and locally test the MatRIS-primary constrained-precondition/release ML-NEB executor and AQCat25 exact fixed-path secondary evaluator; do not deploy or submit a production path until the implementation and smoke-test evidence are reviewed.
payload.submission_boundary: No GPU or VASP job is active or authorized. The MatRIS archive remains local and was not uploaded; the matching checkpoint already present on MZ73 is sufficient for implementation testing.
done_when: The MatRIS-primary executor can precondition the 13-image seed while preserving C-C connectivity and then remove temporary restraints before an ordinary ML-NEB path run.
AQCat25 evaluates the exact same returned structures without relaxation and produces hash-bound relative-energy and movable-force disagreement records.
A bounded MZ73 smoke test passes geometry, provenance, and executor checks before any production GPU-path authorization is requested.
